# Kestrel Air & Plumbing

> Kestrel Air & Plumbing is a family-owned heating, air conditioning and plumbing company in Greater Columbus, Ohio. (Fictional brand; website concept by Codelynx Digital.)

Key facts:
- Services: furnace and heat pump repair and installation, central AC and ductless mini-split repair and replacement, plumbing repair, water heaters (tank and tankless), drain and sewer cleaning, indoor air quality.
- Service area: Columbus, Westerville, Dublin, Hilliard, Worthington, Upper Arlington, Gahanna, New Albany, Powell, Grove City, Reynoldsburg and Delaware, Ohio.
- Hours: office Monday to Saturday 7 am to 8 pm; emergency service 24/7, 365 days a year.
- Phone: (614) 555-0142. Address: 2280 Ridgecrest Commerce Dr, Columbus, OH 43219.
- Pricing: $79 diagnostic visit (waived with repair), $89 tune-up, drain clearing from $149, water heater replacement from $1,595 installed.
- Kestrel Club maintenance plans: Essential $14/month, Comfort $24/month, Total Home $34/month.
- Guarantees: upfront flat-rate prices, on time or $50 off, 90-day "fixed right" warranty.
